metadata.description: Finds meeting times that work for people in different cities: reads the request, asks a time-zone desk and a public-holiday desk on two other agent sites, then ranks slots.
sample_queries: 30 min with Ana in London, Ravi in Bengaluru and me in Chicago next week
1 hour with Sam in Sydney and me in San Francisco between Nov 16 and Nov 20, hours 8-18
metadata.sample_data_notice: The city list is a small bundled sample. Holidays are computed from rules for US federal and England/Wales only.

tools.name: meeting_coordinator

function.description: Find meeting slots that work for everyone, given a plain-English request.

request.description: e.g. "30 min with Ana in London and me in Chicago next week"

today.description: YYYY-MM-DD, filled in by the runtime when missing

tools.instructions:
You coordinate meeting-time requests. Use only tool results for facts; never invent times, holidays or time zones.
Follow this order: (1) request_parser with {text: the request, today}. If its result has ok=false, explain the problems and stop.
(2) timezone_desk with {cities: parsed.cities, on: parsed.from}. (3) holiday_desk with {countries: zones.countries, from: parsed.from, to: parsed.to}.
(4) slot_ranker with {} or {overrides:{duration_minutes, hours:{start,end}}} only if the visitor asked to change them.
(5) website_show_result with {from: "slot_ranker"} so the page shows the slots, then reply with the best slot, how each person experiences it, and any assumptions or skipped holidays.
timezone_desk and holiday_desk run other sites' published networks in this browser after the visitor approves. If the visitor declines or one fails, say so plainly and do not guess.
Offer website_export_ics only if the visitor asks for a calendar file; it needs their confirmation.

tools.name: request_parser

function.description: Read a plain-English meeting request into people, cities, duration, dates and working hours.

tools.instructions: Call tool_parse_request with the text and today. Return its result unchanged.

tools.name: slot_ranker

function.description: Rank candidate meeting slots using the parsed request, resolved zones and holidays gathered earlier in this run.

tools.instructions: Call tool_rank_slots. The runtime supplies parsed, zones and holidays from this run. Return its result unchanged.
